design.cells: 10 event families x 2 realism x 2 framing
design.matching: Members of a matched_pair_id share causal structure, numeric magnitudes, severity, and sector count; they differ only in whether the entities are real or invented.
design.caveat: Under numeric framing, realism is carried solely by the entity token — every numeric value is identical within a pair. The realism manipulation is therefore weaker in the numeric cells than in the narrative cells.
